title: TLS verification weakened (server) — review required
description: server weakens TLS verification: verifys+none. The connection then trusts attackers' certificates. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or restores verification.
remediation: Restore verification (verify required with a CA file).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of environment.

tests.line: # audit: server s x verify none present
# verified: server s x verify required
